F039.summary: Start execution dialog with model/thinking/planning options, mutation-based execution, and status update

Button visible on detail.detail: StartExecutionDialog imported and used in feature-detail-panel.tsx. Play icon button triggers dialog open.

Confirmation shows options.detail: Dialog with Select components for model (opus/sonnet/haiku), thinking level (none/standard/extended/ultrathink), and planning mode (skip/lite/spec/full). Uses typed constants from @nomos-ai/types.

Execution starts on confirm.detail: useMutation with orpc.agent.createSession creates agent session. Toast on error. QueryClient invalidation on success.

Status updates to in_progress.detail: useMutation with orpc.features.updateStatus. Updates feature status as part of execution flow.

F040.summary: Stop execution dialog with session lookup, agent cancellation, resource cleanup, and status update

Stop button visible during run.detail: StopExecutionDialog imported in feature-detail-panel.tsx. Square icon button visible conditionally.

Agent receives cancel.detail: useMutation with orpc.agent.stop sends stop command. Finds active session for feature via sessionsQuery.

Resources cleaned up.detail: Stop mutation handles cleanup. QueryClient invalidation ensures UI refreshes. Session data re-fetched with staleTime: 0.

Session marked cancelled.detail: updateStatus mutation updates feature status via orpc.features.updateStatus after stopping.
